name: pi-agent-manager
displayName: Pi Coding Agent for VS Code
description: Unofficial chat for the Pi coding agent in VS Code and Cursor. Agents open in editor tabs, several side by side, or in a single side-bar chat. Runs your locally installed and configured pi CLI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Pi Coding Agent for VS Code launches the local pi executable and reads workspace-scoped Pi session files.

enumDescriptions: Open each Pi agent in its own editor tab. Run several agents side by side, each with its own Pi session.
Keep a single Pi chat in the side bar.
piAgentManager.defaultLocation.markdownDescription: Where **New Pi Agent** and the other chat commands open Pi. Editor tabs are restored when the window reloads.

enumDescriptions: Open each Pi agent as a chat in its own editor tab, with its own Pi session.

Open each Pi agent as a terminal running interactive Pi in its own editor tab, with its own Pi session. The side bar keeps the chat UI. The terminals are reopened with their sessions after a window reload.
piAgentManager.tabMode.markdownDescription: What **New Pi Agent** opens in editor tabs. `terminal` runs plain interactive Pi in a terminal instead of the chat UI. Only applies when `piAgentManager.defaultLocation` is `editor`.

piAgentManager.command.description: Executable name or absolute path of the Pi CLI.

piAgentManager.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to Pi, both `pi --mode rpc` for the chat and interactive `pi` in terminal tabs (for example `--offline` or `--provider anthropic`). Session and mode flags are managed by the extension.

piAgentManager.maxContentWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum width, in pixels, of the chat transcript and composer. When the view is wider, they stay centered at this width. Set to `0` to always fill the view.

enumDescriptions: Expand edits to show their diff, and codemode scripts that made edits; fold other tools, including writes.
Fold every tool card, showing only its header and summary.
piAgentManager.expandToolCards.markdownDescription: Which tool cards in the chat start expanded. Click a card's header to expand or fold it.

piAgentManager.loadShellEnvironment.markdownDescription: Start Pi with the variables your login shell sets up (API keys, company gateway settings, MCP tokens, `PATH`), even when VS Code was not started from a terminal. Variables VS Code already has are kept. Not used on Windows.

piAgentManager.environment.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for Pi, such as a gateway base URL. Do not put API keys here; use **Pi Coding Agent for VS Code: Set Environment Secret…**, which stores them encrypted.
